versions.short: The bill would take about 265 acres of land in El Dorado County, California, into trust for the Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians. It would revoke an existing public land order that had reserved the land for use by the Forest Service as an experiment station, and move the land from the Forest Service to the Department of the Interior. The land would combine about 80 acres of federal land managed by the Bureau of Land Management with about 185 acres of land the tribe already holds, and would become part of the tribe's reservation. The bill would also prohibit gaming on the land taken into trust.
